title: RFC005 §40 checkpoint selection policy (DEC-041 A)
$comment: Closed envelope, v1. Carries no embedded self-hash -- like s2_stage_gate_policy.schema.json, its identity (domain rfc005.s4-selection-policy/v1) is a domain_hash over the whole validated document, computed by unflatten.model.s4_selection_policy, never stored inside it. `gates` is an ordered list, levels 1..7 of RFC005 §40.1's eight-level lexicographic order (hard contract/security/exposure; exact text/structure minimum; strict-valid/renderer-ready minimum; critical-slice non-regression; typed/table/layout/resource macro metrics; P5 development quality; review/partial/failure behavior). Level 8 (§40.1's own 'performance tie-break') is `tie_break`, a single field, not a floored gate -- it only orders candidates that tie on every gate above. Every rate is carried in MICRO-units (see s2_stage_gate_policy.schema.json's comment: the deterministic CBOR profile these identities hash under has no float in its data model). `is_placeholder` on a gate marks a floor the owner has not yet ratified (DEC-035 §5); `unflatten.model.select_checkpoint` refuses to declare a 'best' checkpoint while any gate carries `is_placeholder: true`, unless run with --report-only, in which case it ranks and reports but declares no best. `cohort.pinned_pages` is the frozen selection cohort (val_iid only, RFC005 §40.4 -- never a calibration split); it must be disjoint from the run's own `s4_eval_pages.json` diagnostic-eval pages, checked by the tool against the run directory at load time, not by this schema.

note.description: free-text provenance/caveat note, e.g. marking an illustrative cohort pending the owner's real val_iid pin -- never read by select_checkpoint

decode.$comment: RFC005 §12.2: selection uses production-equivalent free-running output -- typed heads (level 5), NodeVisualAligner regions (image recovery) and the DEC-036 loop guard, exactly as eval/s2_gate --typed-decode/--region-decode/--loop-guard.

gates.$comment: Schema 1.0.0 documents carry exactly one gate per level 1..7. Schema 1.1.0 (fresh S4, DEC-055 V5) may carry more than one gate per level; within a level the list order is the lexicographic order. Enforced by unflatten.model.s4_selection_policy (a >7-gate document must declare s4_selection_policy_schema_version 1.1.0).

floor_source.$comment: RFC005-ERRATA-005 E3 (owner decision 2026-09-24): a gate's floor MAY be derived from a reference checkpoint ('not worse than v14-r4') rather than a fixed number the owner typed in. kind='fixed' (default reading when this field is absent entirely) makes no claim beyond the gate's own floor_micro. kind='reference' records the provenance select_checkpoint.propose_reference_floors computed it from -- validate_s4_selection_policy recomputes floor_micro = max(0, reference_value_micro - margin_micro) and refuses a mismatch, so a hand-edited floor can never silently disagree with its own recorded provenance.
